Date Sept 19 32 3.19 32

Subject (in full) V.A. Rubeloff alias Rubloff.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshanoff. Forwarded by (签名)

Further enquiries made regarding V.A. Rubeloff show
that this individual left Shanghai for Chefoo about one month
ago and is at present residing at 11, 36 Taiping Road, Chefoo.
He is carrying on business as a broker and a sales agent and in
this venture is assisted by his wife V.A. Rubeloff née Trent.
This lady arrived in Shanghai from Chefoo about one week ago
and is at present residing with her parents at 4, 777 Rue
Joffre. V.A. Rubeloff is expected to arrive in
Shanghai from Chefoo on or about September 9. No information
has been received regarding Rubeloff's connection with the sale
of "Gas Pistols," but it is known that he is on friendly terms
with E. Widler who is reported to be dealing in this class of
weapon.

It is reported that E. Widler who left Shanghai for
Tsingtao on August 9, by the s.s. "Oteromaru," returned here
on August 27 by the s.s. "Dairen Maru." It is believed that he
has stored in his residence, Flat 617, Embankment Building, North
Soochow Road, a considerable number of gas pistols which he
obtained from an Italian steamer and that the pistols are
delivered to purchasers by both his wife Mrs. Widler and her
sister. Information from another source indicates that one
S. H. Pan (潘三星), merchant, connected with the "Protector"
Co., 95 Jinkee Road is also an agent for the sale of gas pistols.
He resides at 14 An Loh Fong off Bubbling Well Road. Rubeloff
at one time was employed with this concern and it is believed
that he (Pan) has some connection with Widler.

DC(Crime)
Information
The Detective Supt.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

制作人 D.S. Tcheremshanoff。转发人 (签名)

针对 V.A. Rubeloff 进行的进一步调查显示，
此人约于一个月前离开上海前往烟台，目前居住在
烟台太平路36号11室。他从事经纪人和销售代理业务，
其妻子 V.A. Rubeloff（婚前姓 Trent）协助其开展此项业务。
这位女士约于一周前从烟台抵达上海，目前与其父母同住
于霞飞路777号4室。预计 V.A. Rubeloff 将于9月9日左右
从烟台抵达上海。尚未收到关于 Rubeloff 与“瓦斯手枪”
销售有关联的情报，但已知他与 E. Widler 关系友好，据报
后者正经营此类武器。

据报，E. Widler 于8月9日乘“大和丸”号（Oteromaru）轮船
离开上海前往青岛，并于8月27日乘“大连丸”号（Dairen Maru）
轮船返回上海。据信，他在北苏州路堤岸大厦617室的住所内
储存了大量从一艘意大利轮船上获得的瓦斯手枪，这些手枪由
其妻子 Widler 夫人及其妹妹交付给买家。来自另一来源的情报
显示，一名与静安寺路95号“Protector”公司有关的商人
S. H. Pan（潘三星）也是瓦斯手枪的销售代理。他居住在
静安寺路附近的安禄坊14号。Rubeloff 曾受雇于该公司，
据信他（Pan）与 Widler 有某种关联。

Date January 19, 1934

Subject (in full) V.A. Rybakoff alias Rebikoff alias Robakieff.

Made by D.S. Tcheremsensky. Forwarded by [Signature]

With reference to the D.I. (Crime) memo of December
24, 1931, on the subject of V.A. Rybakoff and his connections
with Elly Widler and Paul S Crawley, enquiries show that Rybakoff
is on friendly terms with both Widler and Crawley and is believed
to have had dealings with Widler as far back as 1929, when he
(Rybakoff) was then employed with the Protector Co. No.25 Jinkee
Road, a firm dealing in Bullet Proof Devices and Bullet Proof
Glass. Widler, it is known, was one of the first persons to
introduce this class of goods into China. The acquaintance of
Crawley and Rybakoff is believed to date back to 1922-23. At
this time the first named was operating a gambling den in Harbin.
Crawley was later arrested and fined $500 for this offence.
During 1927 Crawley, who had arrived in Shanghai some time
previous, renewed his connections with Rybakoff, who was then the
manager of the now defunct "Palais de Danse", No.55A Bubbling
Well Road.

In June 1931 Rybakoff left Shanghai for North China
and Manchuria. It is rumoured that this trip was taken in
connection with the object of demonstrating to certain Northern
Generals the value and efficiency of a certain "liquid fire"
apparatus in which they were interested. It was intended, that
Rybakoff should act as advance agent and when he had aroused
sufficient interest among prospective purchasers, the other two
individuals would then proceed North and if successful in their
negotiations would demand a substantial cash deposit in advance
prior to the delivery of any goods ordered. With the reputation
that Crawley and Widler have established for themselves in China,
and the absence of any stock, it is easy to believe that the
prospective purchasers would undoubtedly have been swindled out.

*
see D. 775.

制作人 D.S. Tcheremsensky。转发人 [签名]

关于1931年12月24日副总监（刑事）备忘录中提及的
V.A. Rybakoff 及其与 Elly Widler 和 Paul S Crawley 的关联，
调查显示 Rybakoff 与 Widler 和 Crawley 均关系友好，并据信
早在1929年就与 Widler 有过交易往来，当时他（Rybakoff）
受雇于静安寺路25号的 Protector 公司，这是一家经营防弹装置
和防弹玻璃的公司。众所周知，Widler 是最早将此类商品引入
中国的人之一。据信 Crawley 与 Rybakoff 的相识可追溯至
1922-23年。当时前者在哈尔滨经营一家赌场。Crawley 后来
因此罪行被捕并被罚款500美元。1927年间，此前已抵达上海的
Crawley 恢复了与 Rybakoff 的联系，当时 Rybakoff 是现已倒闭的
位于静安寺路55A号的“Palais de Danse”（舞宫）的经理。

1931年6月，Rybakoff 离开上海前往华北和满洲。
有谣言称，此次出行是为了向某些北方将领展示他们感兴趣的
某种“液体火焰”装置的价值和效能。计划由 Rybakoff 担任
前期代理，当他在潜在买家中激起足够的兴趣后，另外两人
将北上，如果谈判成功，将在交付任何订购货物之前要求支付
大额定金。鉴于 Crawley 和 Widler 在中国建立的声誉，以及
没有任何库存的事实，很容易相信潜在买家无疑会被骗走钱财。

*
见 D. 775。

Another meeting place of these individuals, prior

had a financial interest. This shop is at present under the
joint ownership of two Chinese named Lee Woo Ling (李杜林)

of opium into the U.S.A. Both these individuals reside at
1782 Zung Hou Li (成孝里) off Tongshan Road near Alcock Road.
Regarding this shop it is interesting to note that after operating
for about 4 years, only applied for a licence on September 9,
1931. The application for the licence, which was made by
Crawley, has not yet been granted.

Rybakoff is at present engaged on a commission basis
in the selling of a brand of cigarettes known as "Indian Head",

Subject (in full) Vladimir Alexandrovich Rybakoff alias Rebicoff alias Rebekieff.

Made by...D.S..Tcheremshansky......Forwarded by [Signature]

Inquiries made concerning the above mentioned individual
show that he was born in 18..9 in Petrograd (Leningrad) Russia.
He is ex-captain of the aviation corps of the former Russian
Imperial Army. In 1920 he arrived in Harbin and resided there
until 1925. While in Harbin he was employed for about two years
(1921-1923) as manager of the Chinese Eastern Railway club.
For some time he held a similar post with the "Hotel Modern".
During the period of his residence in Harbin he visited Chan-Chun,
Mukden and Dairen but the nature of his business in those cities
is unknown.
In 1925 Rybakoff arrived in Shanghai from Harbin and was
employed as manager of the now defunct "Palais de Danse", No.53A
Bubbling Well Road and later at the "Charlston" cabaret Rue Chu
Pao San. In October 1925 he left Shanghai for Calcutta, India,
where it is reported that he was employed in the "Grand Hotel"
in that city. In June 1926 he returned to Shanghai from
Calcutta and set himself up as a commission agent.
In 1930 Rybakoff joined the staff of "Protector Co",
Inc. (Importers and Exporters; Special Bullet Proof Steel
Devices and Bullet Proof Glass), No.25 Jinkee Road, and was
employed by this firm for about one year. This concern no
longer exists. Other employees of this firm included Wsevolod
A. Kirkor, alias William Kirk, a suspected smuggler (File A.5415)
and H.Bisbjerg, suspected Arms dealer, who was deported to
I.O.D.775
Denmark on September 2, 1930 (Files:I.O.8283, I.O.9630 & I.O.5962).
On May 23, 1931, Rybakoff was charged under the name of V.A.
Rebekieff in the Shanghai Special District Court with
Trafficking in Arms and was fined $500.00.
On June 6, 1931 he left Shanghai for Dairen and North

对上述个人的调查显示，他于18..9年出生于俄国彼得格勒（列宁格勒）。
他是前俄罗斯帝国陆军航空队的前上尉。1920年他抵达哈尔滨，
并在那里居住至1925年。在哈尔滨期间，他曾受雇约两年
（1921-1923），担任中东铁路俱乐部经理。此后一段时间，他在
“Modern Hotel”（现代饭店）担任类似职务。在哈尔滨居住期间，
他曾访问长春、沈阳和大连，但他在这些城市的业务性质不明。
1925年，Rybakoff 从哈尔滨抵达上海，受雇为现已倒闭的
位于静安寺路53A号的“Palais de Danse”（舞宫）的经理，后来
又在朱葆三路（今溪口路）的“Charlston”歌舞厅工作。1925年10月，
他离开上海前往印度加尔各答，据报他在那里的大饭店受雇。
1926年6月，他从加尔各答返回上海，自立门户担任佣金代理人。
1930年，Rybakoff 加入“Protector Co”, Inc.（进出口商；特种
防弹钢装置和防弹玻璃）的员工队伍，公司地址为静安寺路25号，
他在该公司工作了约一年。该公司已不复存在。该公司的其他员工
包括 Wsevolod A. Kirkor，又名 William Kirk，涉嫌走私者（档案 A.5415）
以及 H.Bisbjerg，涉嫌军火商，他于1930年9月2日被驱逐至
I.O.D.775
丹麦（档案：I.O.8283, I.O.9630 & I.O.5962）。
1931年5月23日，Rybakoff 以 V.A. Rebekieff 之名在上海特区法院
被指控非法贩卖军火，并被罚款500.00美元。
1931年6月6日，他离开上海前往大连和北方

China and returned to Shanghai on November 20, 1931 by s.s.
"Hoten Maru" accompanied by his wife. During his absence from
Shanghai he visited Seoul, Korea, for the purpose of calling upon
the parents of his wife, Hellena Alexandrovna Rybakoff nee
Grant. His father-in-law, a Russian of English extraction
named A. Grant, is an ex-captain of gendarmerie, of the Russian
Imperial Army and was attached to the "White" Intelligence
service during the Civil War. He is at present the manager of
an English Language School in Seoul. Rybakoff also visited
several towns in Manchuria. In Mukden he went into partnership
in a hotel owned by one H. Hreptovich, white Russian, formerly
in the service of later Baron Ungern, former dictator of Outer
Mongolia. But it is reported that the money which he invested
was spent by Hreptovich.
Rybakoff at present living with one Y.F. Lavroff at
421 Route Cardinal Mercier, and is said to be engaged in selling
cigars, cigarettes etc. on a commission basis.

Rybakoff 目前与 Y.F. Lavroff 同住于麦尔西爱路421号，

Sir,

With reference to the attached and in accordance
with your verbal instructions, I introduced P. Charlez
to Chief Insp. Litorne of the French Police in December

between him and the latter authorities.

From information received from Chief Insp.
Litorne on February 5, there does not appear to be
much prospects of any successful results being obtained
as it now transpires Charlez is unable to supply
further information.

I therefore suggest this report be filed.
Any further developments will be forwarded.

A. Robertson

A. Robertson

先生：

1929年12月6日上午11时45分，一名居住在杨氏别墅8号的俄国人P. Cherkez主动提供以下情报，他希望此情报能保密处理，且不令俄国侦探知晓：

住在卡特路26号的Rebicoff先生有以下武器弹药出售：

300支12英寸毛瑟枪，无枪套，每支枪配100发子弹。单价128.00美元。
100支12英寸毛瑟枪，带枪套，每支枪配100发子弹。单价142.00美元。
48支西班牙勃朗宁手枪，每支枪配100发子弹。单价60.00美元。
200支德国步枪，带刺刀和子弹带，每支枪配1000发子弹。单价115.00美元。

本案线人如同在大多数其他案件中一样，期望获得酬金，并且不知道违禁品藏匿何处。为了查明藏匿地点，他提议由刑事侦缉处提供资金，让他前往Rebicoff处购买两支毛瑟枪样品（一支带枪套，一支不带）。Rebicoff随后将离开住所去取样品，届时将由一名华探跟踪，以查出货物的目的地。然而，线人认为毛瑟枪和西班牙勃朗宁手枪藏在法租界某处，而德国步枪据信则在公共租界内，由某些德国人保管。
